name: competitorGeneInfoEnrich
description: Cache-first sitemap walk → per-product-page Observed MW + UniProt extract → upsert into boster_nexus agc_data_sources_cache as type='competitors', key=uniprot_id. Designed to repeat per competitor brand (Proteintech, Boster, Abcam, ...) without code changes — only the source-name + URL regexes vary. The cache row supplies hedged "some scientists report observing it at xx kDa" copy when a competitor's Observed MW differs from Boster's reference.
author: GuildOS
